details.publicNotes:
This animated bowl of crab, rice, and egg soup is the unfortunate result of an arcane cooking experiment on a massive serving dish. It can conjure vestiges of the crabs that were cooked within it, usually in the form of pincers made out of scalding hot broth. It gathers this same broth into a wave beneath it, traveling overland on the wave's crest.

Occasionally, one can spot a vengeful crab bowl roaming the countryside, leading people to speculate that it seeks out its reckless creator to exact revenge. Whatever the case may be, the bowl has an instinctive hatred for humanoids, attacking them on sight.

The vengeful crab bowl is not the only creature to arise from a failed cooking experiment; similar soup bowls and other culinary creatures made from the same or different ingredients can be found across the world. Rumors tell of a crafty group of adventurers who defeated a bowl of vengeful chicken soup by simply spilling the bowl over, and another tale tells of an animated meat skewer that impales its foes.

Kitchen Battles

The appearance of multiple soup-based dishes gaining hateful sentience at once has struck some observers as being too coincidental to be believed. Investigating their common causes, they found that many of the vengeful bowls were said to have originated from cooking contests—and that the same contestant participated in each of these contests, never winning the prize. It's speculated that this contestant might be a mediocre chef but an excellent spellcaster, determined to wreak vengeance on anyone who defeats them in culinary contests, or perhaps a new type of gremlin distantly related to the pilatatry.

Suggested Monster Parts

Monster Parts 30/65/125 gp

Eligible Refinements weapons (bludgeoning), skill items (Acrobatics, Athletics)

Eligible Imbued Properties bane, burning barbs, dexterity, energy resistant (fire, spirit, vitality, void), fire, fire shield, sensory (low-light vision), strength, throwing, water, wild

description.value: Due to being made out of food, the vengeful crab bowl takes 5 additional damage from jaws Strikes, fangs Strikes, or other similar Strikes with a creature's mouth. When it is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} by a creature's jaws, fangs, or mouth, the DC to Escape is increased by 2.

When a vengeful crab bowl is knocked @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}, some of its broth spills out onto the ground. It becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}; this is cumulative with other drained conditions from Spill Vulnerability, to a maximum of @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 4}. Additionally, all creatures within a @Template[type:emanation|distance:10] take @Damage[2d6[fire]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:22|basic] save).

A creature hit by the vengeful crab bowl's egg drop Strike is covered in sticky egg goop, taking a –10 circumstance penalty to their Speeds for 1 minute or until they move a total of 40 feet.

@UUID[Compendium.battlezoo-bestiary-es-pf2e.sf2e-effects.Item.spgAXQKwkd8I5tgS]{Effect: Goopy Egg}

The vengeful crab bowl flies into a boiling rage, superheating its broth. For the next minute, it takes a –1 circumstance penalty to its AC, but deals an additional 1d6 fire damage to creatures it hits with a Strike. Additionally, any creature that hits the crab soup with an unarmed Strike or otherwise touches it during this time takes @Damage[3d6[fire]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:22|basic] save).

The vengeful crab bowl launches a glob of steaming hot rice with a range of 60 feet. When the glob hits the ground, it explodes in a @Template[type:burst|distance:20] of hot steam that persists for 2 rounds. Creatures that start their turn in the area take @Damage[5d6[fire]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:24|basic] save). All creatures within the steam become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}, and all creatures outside the steam become concealed to creatures within it. The vengeful crab bowl can't use Rice Ball for [[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 rounds}.
